"""Download only public cards/paper metadata for source review; execute nothing."""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import requests

root = Path('/home/chase/GitHub/RWKV-LH/data/experiments/OPEN_SOURCE_RESOURCE_REVIEW_R1_20260909')
(root / 'sources').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
sources = {
 'metarsi_paper': 'https://www.cosmosmind.ai/research/metarsi-v1.pdf',
 'rsi_harness_hf_model': 'https://huggingface.co/api/models/CosmosMind/RSI-Harness',
 'rsi_harness_hf_dataset': 'https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/CosmosMind/RSI-Harness',
 'rsi_harness_readme': 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CosmosMind-ai/RSI-Harness/main/README.md',
 'ultra_agent_card': 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/UltraData-SFT-Agent-2609/raw/main/README.md',
 'ultra_rl_card': 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/UltraData-RL-2609/raw/main/README.md',
 'ultra_code_card': 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/UltraData-Code/raw/main/README.md',
 'meshy_readme': 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenBMB/Meshy/main/README.md',
 'meshy_blog': 'https://maydomain.notion.site/meshy-blog-zh',
 'justrl_blog': 'https://panhaoxuan.notion.site/justrl-ii-small-llms-to-128k-reasoning-with-a-critic-cn',
 'justrl_card': 'https://huggingface.co/openbmb/JustRL-II-base-model/raw/main/README.md',
}
def fetch(pair):
    name, url = pair
    record = {'name': name, 'url': url, 'retrieved_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    try:
        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.trust_env = False
            response = session.get(url, timeout=(10, 30))
        record.update(status=response.status_code, final_url=response.url, bytes=len(response.content),
                      content_type=response.headers.get('Content-Type'))
        if response.status_code == 200:
            suffix = '.pdf' if response.content.startswith(b'%PDF-') else '.md' if 'readme' in name or 'card' in name else '.html'
            path = root / 'sources' / (name + suffix)
            path.write_bytes(response.content)
            record.update(path=str(path), sha256=hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest())
    except Exception as exc:
        record.update(error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
    return record
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    records = list(pool.map(fetch, sources.items()))
(root / 'SOURCE_FETCH.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
for record in records:
    print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader


root = Path('/home/chase/GitHub/RWKV-LH/data/experiments/OPEN_SOURCE_RESOURCE_REVIEW_R1_20260909/sources')
reader = PdfReader(root / 'metarsi_paper.pdf')
text = '\n\n'.join(f'--- PAGE {index + 1} ---\n{page.extract_text()}' for index, page in enumerate(reader.pages))
(root / 'metarsi_paper.txt').write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
print(f'pages={len(reader.pages)} chars={len(text)}')
